article_title: Spatially guided in vivo single-cell functional genomics of postnatal heart
table_description: Differentially expressed genes across cell states, 250 rows covering 25 states; 10 supplied markers per state. Not stage-specific. Extracted five CM-state rows-of-groups, total50rows.
extraction: Factual gene/statistic rows copied from author-supplied table. Author p-values are provenance only, not new analysis and not evidence of independent animals.
license_note: Article states CC BY-NC-ND4.0; no full article/images or full supplement republished here. Short exact attributed excerpts and factual table subset supplied.

exact_excerpts.quote: Compared to other v.CMs, these Ankrd1.CMs preferentially localized to the left ventricle and peri-arteriolar regions.
We also identified a distinct population of trabecular cardiomyocytes (Slit2.CMs) enriched within the trabecular layer of the ventricle
CMs located closer to capillary-associated cells exhibit higher maturation index

interpretation_notes: Main text identifies Ankrd1 and Atf3 as mechanosensitive/stress-response-associated markers, with LV/peri-arteriolar enrichment P0-P14 and weaker P21 pattern.
Slit2.CMs are ventricular trabecular-associated in this paper; Etv1/Gja5 are also in their author marker set, so these genes alone do not warrant Purkinje classification.
Ddc.CM marker set includes Hey2/Tnni1/Hmgcs2/Irx4, but main text does not provide an anatomical location for Ddc.CMs. Do not infer compact wall solely from this set.

Paper proposes vascular-proximity maturation coupling through oxygen/nutrients plus endothelial/perivascular signaling; RNA or distance alone does not measure oxygen concentration or establish causality.
